scope: training runtime only; no FlightReady v2 metric, weight, threshold, aggregation, coverage, or decision change
observation: The first clean seed-17 feasibility run at batch 8 used approximately 2.0 GiB of an 8 GiB GPU and required 2279.3 seconds.
justification: Reduce wall-clock cost while keeping one common batch size for all primary conditions. Ultralytics uses nominal batch-size scaling (nbs=64), so gradient accumulation changes consistently across all runs.
status_of_prior_run: Preserved as a feasibility run and excluded from primary analysis. All primary runs, including clean seed 17, are rerun at batch 32.
timing: Declared before any degraded-condition model was trained and before any FlightReady-versus-performance analysis.
